messages:
maria: Heads up — CS asked for a temporary lift for partner RelayLabs (relay-123). They expect a demo spike and are requesting ~15k req/min for ~2 hours. Need ops approval + audit. Anyone object?

jake: Do we have precedent for that exact number? We usually do per-key temporary top-ups with TTL + justification. We should avoid a free-for-all and make it auditable.

ashok: Concern: big lifts can blow out billing and cluster load. Prefer a bounded burst window: e.g., add 3k rps (180k rpm?) for 2 hours rather than unlimited. Also require ticket + CS justification.

maria: CS insists on 15k rpm as peak. They say steady is lower but peak matters for demo. We can gate with circuit-breaker rules.

olivia: UX ask: console should have a "temporary quota" modal that captures reason, expires_at, approver, and a post-mortem checkbox. Show projected cost delta before applying.

maria: For ops-run, proposed CLI example:

```\nredwoodctl quota override --key relay-123 --add-requests-per-minute 15000 --until 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z --reason "Relay demo" --approver @maria
```

jake: Implementation notes: backend keeps overrides in a separate layer (temp_override) that the rate-limiter checks before base quota. TTL enforced by scheduler that removes override at expiry. Add audit entry for apply/revoke.

ashok: Safety: auto-revoke if error rate > 5% for 60s or if cluster CPU/GPU utilization > 75% for 60s. Emit metric `override_revoked_by_safety`. Also limit concurrent overrides per org.

quota-bot: audit: temp override requested by maria for key=relay-123 delta_rpm=15000 expires=2026-03-25T18:00:00Z status=pending-approval

olivia: Who is the approver? Recommend ops/eng-platform rota (2 people) to approve low-risk lifts; anything above a threshold needs product or infra lead sign-off. Also add a one-click "revoke now" in console.

sre-oncall: Limit active overrides per org (e.g., 2) to reduce blast radius. Also add route-level burst caps so a single key can't saturate a route.

jake: Practicality: rate-limiter uses redis token buckets. For temp overrides we can create an `override:{key}` bucket with TTL and let scheduler reconcile counts into main pool. Minimal hot-path change. I'll draft a prototype.

ashok: Audit log format suggestion (plain text):
`override.apply key=relay-123 by=maria delta_rpm=15000 expires=2026-03-25T18:00:00Z reason="Relay demo" ticket=CS-789`

maria: CS wants console ETA — can we ship ops-only CLI this week if the code lands? Otherwise I'll ask them to schedule the demo later.

olivia: I can sketch the modal this afternoon. Backend endpoints we need: POST /admin/keys/:key/overrides and GET /admin/keys/:key/overrides. Will add a cost-estimate hook to the endpoint.

jake: I'll implement CLI + scheduler + tests for TTL and safety revocation. Plan: feature-flag behind ops-only first, then console next sprint.

ashok: I'll add dashboard panels and an alert that fires if overrides push cluster util > 70% or if override_revoked_by_safety increments.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll coordinate with CS and tell RelayLabs it's pending ops approval.

quota-bot: audit: override approved by jake at 1717654378 status=active
